blocking_findings.clarification_needed: Please define: what exactly are the '1-2 parallel tasks'? Are they (a) two LLM models running simultaneously, (b) Claude Code + one LLM inference, or (c) something else?
blocking_findings.description: The requirement 'future 1-2 parallel tasks' is not operationalized. If this means concurrent LLM inference, memory requirements double or triple. If it means Claude Code + LLM inference, memory impact is modest. This directly determines GPU memory floor across all budget tiers.

checks.note: 1 of 8 use case items flagged (parallel tasks ambiguity). Core use cases (macOS, local inference, 60k context, tool calling) are well-specified.
3 of 11 criteria flagged: 'stability' undefined, 'noise' has no threshold, 'cost-performance' has no weighting. 7/11 pass.
4 categories and 3 budget tiers clearly defined. 2 flags for missing Mac model range and cloud provider details.
All 6 evidence elements pass. Source attribution, cross-verification, and prohibitions are clear.
6 of 7 deliverables pass. 'Performance testing protocol' is too vague without benchmark specifications.

summary: The task specification is substantially well-structured with clear use cases, budget tiers, candidate categories, and evidence requirements. However, one critical ambiguity (what 'parallel tasks' means) and seven additional ambiguities (criterion weighting, noise threshold, stability definition, cloud provider, Mac model range, custom model verification, physical constraints) must be resolved before stage 02 DAG generation. Without resolving the parallel tasks ambiguity, memory requirements cannot be properly estimated, and all GPU recommendations across all budget tiers could be wrong. The recommended action is to return a consolidated question packet to the human for clarification, then proceed to stage 02 only after these items are resolved.
